scope: Combined authenticated synthetic journey and recovery evidence, not one uninterrupted passing run

journeyChecks.clientGrant: Client owner granted named preparer/reviewer through real existing protected form

journeyChecks.setup: Draft, assignment, explicit enrollment and activation; assignment alone did not create a link

journeyChecks.handover: Old assignment ended, incoming consent not transferred; explicit second enrollment; work rows unchanged

journeyChecks.revocation: Real client owner form revokes enrolled incoming mandate

journeyChecks.invitation: Actual queued invitation, synthetic worker-failure state; retry visible, acceptance still pending, no grant and no provider called

recoveryChecks: Keyboard confirmation starts on Cancel; Escape returns focus to the triggering control without mutation
Persisted synthetic mandate expiry renders Expired after reauthorization
Aborted server-action read clears private cards; Retry reloads current authorized metadata
Persisted role removal replaces the entire workspace with the existing route permission boundary; restoring permission and reloading recovers
Persisted accounting-module removal denies and clears metadata; restoring the module recovers
Persisted session deletion denies subsequent reads and clears private cards
